en.title: Automatic Flight Control
en.summary: Quadcopter flight control design and testing with sensor feedback.
en.challenge: A quadcopter must estimate attitude and continuously correct four motor outputs fast enough to remain stable despite sensor noise and disturbances.
contribution: Integrated the frame, motors, ESCs, sensors, power system, and microcontroller.
Implemented sensor reading, attitude estimation, PID control, and motor mixing in embedded code.
Tuned and tested the controller iteratively with safety-conscious ground and flight checks.
technical: IMU measurements are filtered into roll, pitch, and yaw estimates.
PID loops compare desired and measured attitude and calculate corrective control signals.
Motor mixing converts control outputs into four ESC commands for the airframe.

architecture.label: Sensing
architecture.detail: IMU measurements capture angular rate and acceleration.

architecture.label: Estimation
architecture.detail: Embedded filtering produces a stable attitude estimate.

architecture.label: Control
architecture.detail: PID loops calculate roll, pitch, yaw, and throttle corrections.

architecture.label: Actuation
architecture.detail: Motor mixing and ESC signals adjust four propellers; motion feeds back to the sensors.

outcomes: Built an end-to-end real-time feedback system across hardware and software.
Developed practical understanding of noisy sensors, controller tuning, and actuator limits.
Established an early foundation for later automation, data, and systems engineering work.

zh.title: 自動飛行控制
zh.summary: 四軸飛行器的控制設計與感測回饋測試。
zh.challenge: 四軸飛行器必須估測姿態，並持續快速修正四顆馬達輸出，才能在感測雜訊與外部擾動下保持穩定。
contribution: 整合機架、馬達、電子變速器、感測器、電源系統與微控制器。
在嵌入式程式中實作感測讀取、姿態估測、PID 控制與馬達混控。
透過重視安全的地面與飛行檢查，反覆調校並測試控制器。
technical: 將 IMU 量測值濾波為滾轉、俯仰與偏航姿態估計。
PID 迴路比較目標與量測姿態，計算修正控制訊號。
馬達混控將控制輸出轉換為四組電子變速器指令。

architecture.label: 感測
architecture.detail: IMU 量測角速度與加速度。

architecture.label: 估測
architecture.detail: 嵌入式濾波產生穩定的姿態估計。

architecture.label: 控制
architecture.detail: PID 迴路計算滾轉、俯仰、偏航與油門修正量。

architecture.label: 致動
architecture.detail: 馬達混控與電子變速器訊號調整四個螺旋槳，運動結果再回饋至感測器。

outcomes: 完成橫跨硬體與軟體的端到端即時回授系統。
累積處理感測雜訊、控制器調校與致動器限制的實務經驗。
奠定後續自動化、資料與系統工程工作的早期基礎。
